entities.summary: Benjamin Jeffrey Maxwell is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre. He was selected in the second round, 49th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2006 NHL Entry Draft. Maxwell also played for the Anaheim Ducks, Atlanta Thrashers and Winnipeg Jets during his National Hockey League career.
